notes.title: V1.19f: Bugfixes and a little touch of fall.
notes.notes:
[p]A crashfix, some bugfixes and some changes that were needed, what more can you wish for? Indeed: some falling leaves in the main menu. Winter is coming! (At least in the Northern hemisphere)[/p][p]If you found a bug or a crash that we haven't caught yet, let us know in the Steam Discussions, we'll have a look.[/p][p align="start"]As always thanks for all your feedback.
[b]If you like the game feel free to leave a review, as this helps us -a lot-![/b]👻[/p][p] [b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Well and Cave now have the same building cost as the Bell Tower.[/p][/*][*][p]Deselect the selected card when ending building so the player can not remove rooms during the transition, potentially destroying the critical path for some rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Endless Tolling from and added Amplify Agony to the pool of cards that can be generated by Improvised Snare.[/p][/*][*][p]Humans with the Skip Turn Hex will stay idle when Compel is used.[/p][/*][*][p]The main menu now contains branches and falling leaves, since it is now Fall![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixed Bugs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Cursed Gift always giving the same Hex from the same copy.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Witch only applying Tension to one person when entering a room.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix shared agony endless loop when more than one human in a room has it.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227801/3b4ee58efb2e45398440c1261fbb5402ca6ab6c8.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: V1.19: Small changes & fixes
notes.notes: [p]Another workday, another batch of fixes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Unhallowed Grounds no longer stacks with itself or other traps.[/p][/*][*][p]Occultists no longer damage the heart when turned insane.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the animation system to try prevent humans being stuck in their animation.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixed Bugs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Echoes of Command not properly doubling values with multiple stacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Creature card frames being used for non-creature cards and vice versa on the upgrade screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Lunar Perigee stack applying twice when a new Creature is spawned.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for all your feedback, [b]if you like the game feel free to leave a review, as this helps us -a lot-![/b]👻[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227801/1393169f913a962fd5010df7dab38cfbf3509971.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Major Content Drop Release Date Update
notes.notes:
[p]We wanted to put something extra in the content drop: a Creature starter deck!
This means that we will have to postpone the content drop for Deck of Haunts by a week. As such, the new date is: Tuesday the 16th of September.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227801/53e8c3312d39ad8f76a2bf86900155688e64c132.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Major Content Drop Release Date
notes.notes:
[p][b]Write it down on your calendars, post-its, walls and haunted items: we'll be releasing the content drop on Tuesday the 9th of September 2025![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Currently we're dotting the i's on the content, testing it, retesting it and trying to polish it as much as possible before releasing it onto the world.[/p][p][/p][p]We've decided to also throw another card preview your way, so here goes: [b]Seismic Bloom.[/b]
As we wanted to create some more usefulness for bigger rooms, this card will become more powerful the more rooms of at least 10 tiles that you have.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227801/336d35cd72ec7e7ac494bd16d268954e3ef14caa.png"][/img][b]If you have missed the previous three content teases, you can check them out here:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3179730/announcements/detail/518593488304996412"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3179730/announcements/detail/518593743825143698"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3179730/view/518594755730342152?l=english"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]If you like the game and the direction we're headed in, feel free to leave a review, as this helps us more than you think![/b]👻[/p][p]And again, a big thank you for playing and all your feedback ❤️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227801/fff2caa7e9f2d074e2e7fc10754649900ff82812.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update V1.15: UI/UX revamp and custom keybinds!
notes.notes:

Within that profile you can start multiple runs (whereas before, you could only have 1 per save slot).[/p][/*][*][p]Custom key bindings.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now see upgrades in the collection.[/p][/*][/list][p]Besides those three major points, we reworked the flow and visuals of the UI and as always fixed some bugs and did some balancing along the way.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227801/ae7f471fe9c0521f87201823ee755de3540c1afa.jpg"][/img][/p][p]While writing this, the team is already working on the next, biggest update for Deck of Haunts yet, that we recently teased: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3179730/view/518591585136411802?l=english"][/dynamiclink](More on that, later!)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Here is the complete changelog for V1.15:[/b][/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reworked UI for menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Added custom key bindings for mouse and keyboard to the settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed save slot name to localized Profile.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the option to have multiple active runs Profile.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the color of the Reroll button to stand out more.[/p][/*][*][p]Unified Echo Chamber notes.notes:

Thanks for all your feedback, [b]if you like the game feel free to leave a review, as this helps us -a lot-![/b]👻[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Stone Masons and Master Stone Masons can no longer have the Destined trait.[/p][/*][*][p]Pressure Haunts[/p][list][*][p]Damage now depends on the Multiplier (x1, x2, x4, x6) form Tension, not just Tension itself.[/p][/*][*][p]Base Damage notes.title: Update V1.12 Human Movement, Changes & Fixes!
notes.notes: [p]End of the week build? How about middle of the week![/p][p][/p][p]The most notable change is how humans now move around the house, making them move more efficiently, which can significantly reduce the waiting time in between turns on high numbered nights with large rooms and groups of humans.[/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Human movement improvements to reduce time between turns in large rooms:[/p][list][*][p]Humans will now roam to and then near the door they intend to take.[/p][/*][*][p]Increase walking speed by 50% while roaming in a room.[/p][/*][*][p]Increase walking speed by 20% if the path they need to travel between turns is long.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Humans spawned by the Helpline trait can no longer have the Helpline trait.[/p][/*][*][p]Collective Toll now correctly updates damage and drain according to the amount of traps in the room description.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixed Bugs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Totem selection with controller for Easy, Normal, and Hard difficulties.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Heal Heart option of the boss reward screen not working with controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed moving upgraded Rooms causing negative Essence values.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Crypt not showing up in card discovery after unlocking it by completing Nightmare 13.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Killing Spree not rewarding AP and Draw when multiplied (through Encore for example) and lethal on an extra trigger.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Relentless doing more damage than displayed by counting itself as a played card.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you've encountered any other bugs or crashes, you're always welcome to log them in the Steam Discussions, we'll have a look at them.[/p][p]And again, a big thank you for playing and all your feedback ❤️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227801/696a0c6b47a0d697454cad32b5d62ec770d79018.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update V1.11 Changes & Fixes!
notes.notes:
[p]We hope a lot of you were able to try out the all new Nightmare mode already, that we just released last Friday! (You unlock it by completing a full 28-night run)
If you did, feel free to leave behind your thoughts on it. If you didn't, well, what are you waiting for?![/p][p]Some bugs were logged by helpful players, and we've got the chance to squash a first batch of them.[/p][p]If you've encountered any other bugs or crashes, you're always welcome to log them in the Steam Discussions, we'll have a look at them.[/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Deafening Silence now also applies to Humans that spawn after playing it.[/p][/*][*][p]Mind Wipe interrupts the investigation of a Human with the Investigator trait.[/p][/*][*][p]Add VFX to the counter for Nightmare 10+.[/p][/*][*][p]Harvesting a Human with the Martyr trait does not give a Rotting Beams card anymore.[/p][/*][*][p]Veiled cards can no longer be removed from the deck during card removal.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixed bugs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a crash when moving or removing rooms with the controller and then trying to target the (re)moved room.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Crypt collider.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Reaper ready VFX showing even without the Crypt built.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Humans with Compass walking back to the door they were going to take when teleported away during their second move.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing translations for Collective Toll.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed possible lowered health Human from normal difficulty night one to avoid potential soft lock in the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some sound effects that were playing twice.[/p][/*][/list][p]Our main focus for this week is bug & crash fixing, so expect another update by the end of this week![/p][p]And again, a big thank you for playing and all your feedback ❤️[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227801/7c25ee8c787681ad6908be5195382d0c5e70e874.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Friday the 13th Update 1.10: Nightmares and Scythes
notes.notes:
[h2]The tolling of the bells has been answered by Death.[/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="hQFwGQ-4jKE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]One month after releasing Deck of Haunts, we're now ready to unleash the largest update yet.
It contains something a lot of you have been wanting, a higher difficulty![/p][p]Before we start off with giving you all of the info, we want to express a big thanks to our community, you give us motivation and energy to keep pumping out all of these updates.
And as always, if you like the game, a review is greatly appreciated, as it helps us a lot![/p][h3]Some of the highlights:[/h3][list][*][p]New game mode: Nightmare (Unlocked through playing a 28-day run first).[/p][/*][*][p]New trap cards and trap starter deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Crypt room and Grim Reaper (Unlocked through completing Nightmare).[/p][/*][*][p]New achievement.[/p][/*][*][p]Portraits of dead humans now disappear to make room.[/p][/*][*][p]New traits.[/p][/*][*][p]Raised the level cap from 10 to 12.[/p][/*][*][p]Most importantly, we added "Jason" to the pool of names for humans, it is Friday the 13th, after all.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227801/7c25ee8c787681ad6908be5195382d0c5e70e874.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]For those that want to know more, let's dive a little deeper.[/h2][p][/p][h3]Nightmare[/h3][p]Instead of just scaling some numbers to make the game more difficult, we've made an entirely new game mode: [b]Nightmare[/b].[/p][p]In Nightmare, you will have to survive 13 Nightmares consisting of 13 nights each.
During those nights you will encounter increasingly difficult curated groups of humans, some of them even containing new traits.
To make matters even more dangerous, every Nightmare will have a specific new modifier applied to it, which will carry over to the next Nightmare.[/p][p]A [b]new mechanic & professional scythe wielder[/b] has also been introduced in Nightmare: the [b]Grim Reaper[/b].
Whenever you kill or drive a human insane, you will collect a soul.
Once you've filled up your meter to 13, you can exchange those souls for a visit from the Grim Reaper, who will Harvest a human in your house of your choosing.[/p][p]If you can survive the final Nightmare, 13, you will have won over the confidence in your haunting skills of the Grim Reaper, and you will be able to permanently add them to your house in other game modes with the [b]Crypt room[/b] that you'll unlock.[/p][p][b]These are the extra unlocks you can achieve in the Nightmare mode:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Upon finishing the first Nightmare: 
- Card: Corpse Explosion.[/p][/*][*][p]Upon finishing the final Nightmare:
- Room: Crypt.
- Card: Sleep Paralysis.
- Achievement.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Trap deck[/h3][p]Upon reaching XP-level 12, you will unlock the new Trap deck.[/p][p]To make trap decks more viable, we've added 5 new trap cards:[/p][list][*][p]Leaking Rust[/p][/*][*][p]Improvised Snare[/p][/*][*][p]Collective Toll[/p][/*][*][p]Amplify Agony[/p][/*][*][p]Dragged Under[/p][/*][/list][h3]Some smaller additions[/h3][p]For some quality of life and more polish, we've added some other things to the game, such as:[/p][list][*][p]Death animation of the heart, when you lose a night.[/p][/*][*][p]Removal of portraits of dead humans.[/p][/*][*][p]Setting a counter of turns on humans with the "Helpline" trait.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227801/2366b65e90aedfd00231a1dddf44ac3281380d14.gif"][/img][/p][h2]The full changelog.[/h2][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Hard mode with curated nights.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Nightmare mode with curated nights .[/p][/*][*][p]Added Trap Deck to deck selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new Cards:[/p][list][*][p]Leaking Rust[/p][/*][*][p]Improvised Snare[/p][/*][*][p]Collective Toll[/p][/*][*][p]Amplify Agony[/p][/*][*][p]Dragged Under[/p][/*][*][p]Corpse Explosion[/p][/*][*][p]Sleep Paralysis[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added Crypt Room.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved modifier/totem selection to the Deck selection screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an Achievement for Completing Nightmare mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed portraits of dead Humans.[/p][/*][*][p]Added death animation for the heart.[/p][/*][*][p]Balance cards:[/p][list][*][p]Deepening Shadows: Is now a rare card instead of uncommon[/p][/*][*][p]Unending Madness: Now costs 2 AP (From 1)[/p][/*][*][p]Triskaphobia: Upgraded version now costs 2 AP, Drain 2 thrice instead of 3 AP, Drain 3 thrice[/p][/*][*][p]Cascading mechanism: Now costs 1 AP (from 2)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added new traits:[/p][list][*][p]Martyr: Adds a useless card to your deck for the rest of the night when killed.[/p][/*][*][p]Destined: Dies upon reaching the Heart, takes max 1 damage 1 drain per turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Wary: Flees at the sight of insane humans.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bell Crush ignores Traits that limit damage.[/p][/*][*][p]New basic room floor material during the day phase, also increasing its performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Update the amount of turns until an extra Human spawns for the Helpline Trait in the Human portraits.[/p][/*][*][p]Raised Level cap to 12.[/p][/*][*][p]Added “Jason” as name to the name-pool.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixed Bugs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where undo didn’t always work properly for room upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Panicky trait not working properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Bell Crush animation not playing on the upgraded card.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Slasher achievement tracking not notes.title: Biggest update yet V1.07 Including starter decks and newly curated runs!
notes.notes:
We're very proud to push this update live, as we know it is something that a lot of you have been wanting since release day... [b]Starter decks and a more varied run-system!
[/b]
Always wanted to try a Sanity or Damage driven deck? Time to try that out.
Or, if you are a player that loves to give themselves over to the "luck of the draw", there is also a chaos starter deck now that will select cards from your unlocked collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227801/e46eec5ded8d93541e145a24eddbc9be3de12c65.gif[/img]

Apart from the starter decks (more of them to come as well in the future!), we've also spent some time on revamping the runs themselves.
Added to the now "Classic" very first run, where you previously could only re-run pretty much the same thing (albeit with some minor variation in stats/human amount/traits), we now have a run-system that will, every night, pick from a selection of more curated nights.

So, where in one run you might have a night where you get a solid group of high health regenerative humans with doctor bags that spawn in just 1 wave, in the next run that very same night might instead have you encounter 6 waves of fragile, steadfast humans with a compass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227801/6e50b2c2e824c0709cdf236ed187b081ad24dfd9.gif[/img]

The beauty of this system is, that we can keep on adding different curated runs into the mix to make sure you get an increased amount of variations in your runs!

As a sneak peek: we're currently creating a set of new cards to add to the game, together with a new starter deck type.

[b]And as always, the changelog for this update:[/b]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Added starter deck selection: Default, Damage, Drain, and Chaos.
[*]Added a new run system, to include a variety of nights during a run, that will be differently configured every time you start a new run.
[*]Prevent the same cards from showing up immediately when rerolling.
[*]Balance: Card: Midnights Strike: Change from Any Human to Solo Human target.
[*]Balance: Card: Unending Madness: Change from being Uncommon to Rare.
[*]Balance: Card: Rumbling Lure: Banish now by default, Upgrade does not banish but now costs 3AP.
[*]Balance: Card: Cascading Mechanism: Default AP from 1 to 2, Upgraded AP from 0 to 1.
[*]“Solitary” achievement trigger now works if multiple Mirror Halls are used.
[*]Changed the "Play" button in the main menu to say "Continue" when a run is still in progress.
[*]Added a global limitation to the number of possible concurrent sounds.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed damage check for “Unseen” achievement trigger.
[*]Removed a mirror causing pathfinding issues in the Mirror Hall.
[*]Fixed German localization errors for “unheilvolles Omen”, “Nadelstiche” and “Wurzeln zurückerobern”.
[*]Fixed Storage Room icon tooltip showing “SACRIFICE” to now say "STORE".
[/list]
[b]A big thank you for playing Deck of Haunts, and for all your wonderful feedback.[/b]
As developers, we're not done with this game, and if you like our heading (and the game in it's current state of course ;) ), it would be great if you[b] leave us a review, it helps a ton![/b]

notes.title: Huge Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Open the gates of your eerie domain and prepare yourself to haunt a fresh batch of unfortunate humans!

While working on the full game, we've also completed a huge update to our demo, with the key points being:
[list]
[*]5 New cards to haunt with
[*]2 New rooms to torment with
[*]2 Extra nights
[*]A complete overhaul of the day/building-phase
[/list]
You can find a full list below.

[previewyoutube=u65EVUkomRQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We at Mantis Games cannot wait to see what configurations you can come up with, so feel free to post them here on the Steam Hub, on our [url=http://discord.gg/s4Qu6pg7D7]Discord[/url] server or on our Socials!

And of course, if you like the demo, don't forget to wishlist, as this helps us enormously!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227801/712eb778b728199cbf190568eb6bb7d07069d5a0.jpg[/img]

[b][u]FULL CHANGELOG[/u][/b]

[b]Changes[/b]

[b]Building:[/b]
    - Changed “Upkeep” to “Sustain” and updated building system with expanded Sustain to encourage building closer to the heart and discourage clustering small rooms.
    - Added an Undo button for all building actions.
    - Made rooms movable even if they break the critical path to the heart for some rooms. This includes the entrance room.
    - Remove Room card is free in the shop.
[b]Humans:[/b]
    - Added staggered waves so not all humans arrive at the same time.
    - Added pathfinder trait. These humans will enter through a backdoor.
    - Increased font size for traits in the portrait.
[b]Cards:[/b]
    - Added new cards:
        - Killing Spree
        - Marked by the House
        - Unending Madness
        - Manifest Fears
        - Recurring Demise
    - Increased cost for Move cards (Shifting Hallways, Compel, Collapsing Spaces).
    - Added an animation when cards are played, Discarded and Banished.
    - Gave Hidden Corpse trap a separate VFX.
    - Added VFX for Coiling Madness.
    - Added VFX for Gathering Miasma.
    - Added VFX for Body and Soul.
    - Updated card arts.
[b]Rooms:[/b]
    - Added new rooms:
        - Mechanical Room: Reduces Sustain cost of adjacent rooms.
        - Weapon Room: Doubles the damage you do to humans inside.
    - Phobia Room now does Sanity drain based on the amount of adjacent rooms.
    - Descriptions and formatting have been improved.
[b]Controller Support[/b]
    - Added hover for Humans, Rooms and Nightlong effect icons.
    - Added Controller prompts for PlayStation controller.
    - Added Controller support for the settings screen.
- Added 2 extra nights.
- Added a Glossary in the pause menu.
- Balanced Essence gain and costs.
- Immediately reflect gained Essence in UI.
- Added a custom tooltip visual override.
- Added stack amounts to the Nightlong effects icons.
- Added Keyboard shortcuts:
    - Undo: “Ctrl“ + “Z”
    - End Turn: “Enter “or “E”
- Added the option to disable the tutorial popups.
- Added the option to add a list of custom names for the Humans.
- Added Credits screen.
- More UI VFX.
- Azrael roaming.

[b]Fixed Bugs[/b]

- False Lead Idle turn is no longer ignored due to grouping behavior.
- Fixed Room based VFX not triggering when played via a Human target in the room.
- Fixed Collapsing spaces VFX.
- Target Room door now highlights consistently for all Humans when hovered.
- Settings menu adjusts to language setting.
- All sounds are now affected by the sound settings.
- Fixed the harvest being ignored when the last human is driven insane AND harvested with Consume.
- Fixed Compel moving an insane Human, but their mesh stays in place. It now no longer affects Insane Humans though it can still be played on them.
- Dead and Insane Humans no longer show a highlighted door when hovered.
- Fixed VFX not despawning and retriggering when changing effects quality setting.
- Fixed Pin Pricks cost not resetting when it was in hand at the end of the night.
- It’s no longer possible to click end building while moving a room.
- Fixed grouping behavior causing Humans not to act if the leader was interrupted.
- Fixed grouping behavior causing Humans to move twice if they follow a leader into a room with another leader.
- Fixed Window Mode resetting between menu and game scenes.
- Fixed a calculation mistake in the shortest path to the heart.
- Fixed escaping warning message not disappearing when the Human has escaped and not updating to the shorter path if another Human panics closer to the exit.
- Updated Nav Mesh generation to avoid Humans getting stuck inside objects.
- Fixed spawning of doors on rooms consisting of multiple merged tiles. These doors would not open or highlight when explorers wanted to use them.
- Fixed Phobia room triggering.
- Fix being able to press confirm discard with a controller without having the required amount of cards selected.
- Fixed Stone Masons skipping a turn after being moved with From The Cracks
- Fixed Weapon room not being loaded on the second save file load.
- Fixed Confirm Discard working with controller if not enough cards are selected.

As always, thank you very much for the support!
